We need to finally produce answer after obtaining template IDs. We have sulfonamide template IDs (733, 1313644, 828436). Choose one that matches our reactants: sulfonyl chloride (p-toluenesulfonyl chloride) and aniline. Template 733 seems to be Cl-S(=O)2-aryl + aniline -> sulfonamide. Good.

Now need amide formation template. Let's search again but maybe need to include "primary amines". Let's try functional_groups_broken ["aromatic carboxylic acid"], functional_groups_formed ["amide"], functional_groups_formed also maybe "primary amines"? Actually broken includes acid, formed includes amide. Let's try again.
